title: The gold pot
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The trophy: a crab pot spray-painted gold, the same pot every year, repainted. Gully repaints it. The gold goes on over fifteen years of gold. Wood draws the layers at the edge where they chip.

panels.composition: The launch's gravel. A crab pot on newspaper. GULLY with a can of gold spray paint. WOOD and BARNABY upwind.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager spray-painting a crab pot gold on newspaper on gravel while a young man and a dog stand upwind, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pot's rim: chipped, and in the chip fifteen layers of gold like tree rings.

image.prompt: close on a spray-painted crab pot's rim where a chip reveals many layers of old gold paint, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's pad: the chip, the layers, counted. Fifteen.

image.prompt: close on a drawing pad showing the layered edge of a chipped painted rim rendered in fine lines, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The gold pot drying on the dock. The bay behind it. It's the brightest thing in the strip's whole year, and it's gray on the page.

image.prompt: a freshly gold-painted crab pot drying on a dock above gray water, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Fifteen layers of gold in the chip. The brightest thing in the year, gray on the page.
